sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.336 - Stable

  • Everything and Builder Tools: Ranked fuzzy navigation now covers pages, elements, WordPress admin destinations, plugins, Settings, and Bricks scopes, alongside the approved variable, class, attribute, and bulk workflows.
  • Media Studio in Bricks: Picker mode selects the first visible item initially, remembers the last selected attachment, and removes routine open/insert success toasts.
  • Class workflows: Mimam's Bar class suggestions, duplication, inline editing, and in-place global rename now preserve class IDs, styles, and references while blocking duplicate names.
  • Studio and Recovery: Includes cumulative Content Studio, Media Studio, shared picker, fullscreen/default-state, import, portability, and guarded Recovery improvements through v1.3.336.

v1.3.289 - Stable

  • Private endpoint protection: MV settings export and Recovery portability no longer include private update-feed or license-server URLs; normal Core, Modules, Bar, and Studio preferences remain portable.
  • Variable migration: Advanced Themer palettes, generated shades, long fluid scales, aliases, and renamed scale families now migrate with clearer previews, snapshots, source filtering, and recovery controls.
  • Studio system: Content, Media, CSS, Plugin, Variable, Settings, and Recovery surfaces share the detached rail, single-panel ownership, bounded tooltips/dropdowns, panel sizing, and module activation behavior.
  • Recovery: Added guarded backup/restore stages, encrypted import reuse, destination-admin preservation, prefix mapping, cache repair, settings portability verification, package integrity checks, and post-restore Studio access recovery.
  • Content Studio: Added the redesigned outline/canvas/rail editor, semantic Structure hierarchy, block menus, image actions, taxonomy, SEO previews, responsive Preview, light/dark canvas, and shared editing controls.
  • Media and shared UI: Unified color controls, alpha-aware color output, MV dropdowns, switches, checkboxes, tooltips, icon rhythm, and panel-safe positioning across product surfaces.
  • Security and reliability: Hardened CORS and pairing codes, bundled Preact/CodeMirror locally, fixed backup archive/checksum races, and kept MV CodeMirror styling scoped away from other Bricks plugins.

v1.3.203 - Stable

  • Everything mode: Press 0 to search grouped Bar commands, current-page elements, and Add Element results.
  • Per-surface startup: Admin and Builder have separate default modes and remember-last-mode toggles.
  • Master shortcut: Fresh preferences default to Ctrl+K while saved choices remain unchanged.
  • Builder polish: Fixed Structure spacing in the Advanced Themer shortcut-sidebar layout, result wrapping, Emmet semantic insertion/progress, mode menus, inline chip editing, and update rollback history.

v1.3.144 - Stable

  • Static Locked Collection Icons: Locked collection icons are now static to prevent accidental open/move on click. Unlock remains available via the right-click menu.
  • Drag Reorder Labels: Refined drag label context to show clear “Before [collection]” and “After [collection]” state labels.
  • Nesting Drag Ease: Positioned the nested child drop zone closer for easier parent-child promotion/demotion.

v1.3.143 - Stable

  • Tree-Aware Collection Ordering: Children remain structured beneath parents even during layout order changes.
  • Add Media Hover Fixes: Clears hover highlights and selections correctly during cancelled/incomplete media drag states.

v1.3.132 - Stable

  • WordPress-Backed Media Collections: Collections are now stored as a dedicated WordPress attachment taxonomy (mv_media_collection), making them loopable via Bricks Query Loops and the new [mv_media_collection] shortcode.
  • URL Import and Sideload: Directly download, validate, and register external HTTP(S) media file links into the WordPress Media Library with SSRF, MIME, and size guards.
